architecture:
System: Mission-API-115
Primary NIST family: Planning (PL); evidence focus: PL-2.
Environment: AWS Commercial. Network access uses VPC interface endpoints; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: security and privacy program plans are maintained with accountable owners and review dates. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
